caption: The drawing depicts a pouch with colorful beadwork showing a village scene. The pouch features two horizontal layers of small houses in various colors, including yellow, pink, blue, and red. The houses have roofs in red, blue, or green, and are surrounded by green trees and shrubbery. In the upper section of the pouch there is a tall building, possibly a church, with a tower and a blue roof, located centrally among other smaller structures. The beadwork is bordered along the top by a zigzag pattern in blue, pink, white, and red, with a strip of red below it. The background color behind the houses is light blue, and the bottom layer displays two additional houses with green trees between them. The edge of the pouch is slightly frayed, and the entire object is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Beaded Bag
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
